DEFECT DESCRIPTION DEFECT SL NO L-1838 Electric Motor(0.5HP,415V,Port side,Qty:01 No) of bull walk system i s not working.Suspect both motors to be jammed. Defect to be rectif ied for satisfactory operation. Following jobs are as follows: 1.1 Record insulation of motor prior to dismantling 1.2 Dismantle motor and withdraw rotor/braking mechanism 1.3 Clean stator and rotor with fresh water followed by trichloro e thyl cleaner 1.4 Dry with hot air blower and apply thin layer of quick drying th ermal conductivity varnish 1.5 Replace both bearings of each motors 1.6 Paint internal and external parts of motors 1.7 Change motor terminal lugs,if required 1.8 Change motor terminal cover Gasket 1.9 Check Motor Terminal strip/post and replace, if found cracked 1.10 Check insulation and record the values and carryout trials(mi n resistance-1 Mega Ohm) 1.11 Control panel to be inspected and if any defect persists, repai r /renewal to be carried out 1.12 Servicing and functional testing of electric braking mechanis m including renewal of worn brake pads and springs 1.13 Load Testing and operational trial post overhauling and oper ational trial post overhauling and fitment L-1842 Abnormal noise observed from AMR compartment supply Fan Motor (1.1 KW,415 V,3 ph) fitted at port catwalk.Suspect motor bearing is defective. The defect to be rectified and proved for satisfactory oper ation .
